title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-q3hb: public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options regression — cumulative CoAP option overflow accepted
description: The test `public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options` expects all malformed inner CoAP options to be rejected with `OscoreError::InvalidParam`. The test case `&[0xe0, 0xfe, 0xf2, 0x10]` ("Cumulative option number overflow") now decrypts successfully and returns Ok instead of Err. This is likely a regression in inner CoAP option validation within `unprotect_request` or in the option delta-length parser. Not caused by the `reserve_sender` change — the encryption should produce identical ciphertext.
